description: Singlemodal registration using Gradient Difference (GD). Useful for structural alignment where edge information dominates. GD uses Sobel-based gradient differences and does not require voxel subsampling.
notes: GD (--rho / --rhoderivative) is a Sobel-gradient-based metric. It works best on singlemodal images with well-defined edges (e.g. CT-CT, MRI-MRI). No random subsampling: all voxels are used. Set --mainmetric 5 when using derivativemode 2 to scale gradients to the GD reference.
